title: Norse myths
examples: Who was the most powerful god in Norse myths?
What is the name of the giant world tree?

explain.say: Today we learn about Norse myths from a faraway land. We will meet some very famous gods and stories.
Odin was a very wise and powerful god. He often sought knowledge through great sacrifice.
Thor was known for his incredible strength. He carried a mighty hammer called Mjolnir.
Loki was a tricky god who caused many problems. He was known for his mischief and clever plans.
The world is supported by a giant tree called Yggdrasil. It connects the different realms together.
The end of the world is called Ragnarök. It is a great battle of gods and giants.

items: What: Great battle of gods and giants

faq.q: Why is Yggdrasil so important in the myths?
faq.a: Yggdrasil is important because it holds up the entire world. It connects all the different realms together in the cosmos.

faq.q: Is Loki always bad in the stories?
faq.a: Loki is tricky, but he is not always purely evil. His actions often cause trouble, but he can be complex.
After the great battle of Ragnarök, the world is destroyed but a new world will rise again. Life continues after the end.

faq.q: Who is the most powerful god among the three?
faq.a: Odin is often seen as the chief god, the All-Father. He rules over the other gods in the myths.

faq.q: What is Mjolnir, and who uses it?
faq.a: Mjolnir is the powerful hammer belonging to Thor. He uses it to fight giants and keep order.

facts: The Norse gods lived in a mythological world.
Yggdrasil is the massive tree connecting the realms.
Ragnarök describes the final twilight of the gods.
Thor fights giants using his hammer, Mjolnir.

quiz.say: Which god is known for his wisdom and sacrifice?
quiz.why: Odin is described as the wise All-Father god in the myths.

wrong.0: Thor is known more for his physical strength.
wrong.1: Loki is famous for causing mischief and tricks.
wrong.2: Yggdrasil is the tree, not a god.

quiz.say: What is the name of the world tree supporting the cosmos?
quiz.why: Yggdrasil is the name given to the giant tree holding the realms.

wrong.0: Mjolnir is the name of Thor's hammer.
wrong.1: Ragnarök is the name of the end battle.
wrong.2: Asgard is a realm, but not the tree itself.

quiz.say: The great battle marking the end of the world is called:
quiz.why: Ragnarök is the specific term for the end of the gods and world.

wrong.0: This is a general description, but not the myth's title.
wrong.1: This word describes repetition, not the end event.
wrong.3: This sounds like the end, but it is not the proper myth name.
